internal_design_observations.label: Cover norm projection for relation arithmetic
internal_design_observations.author: root control-plane session
internal_design_observations.statement: For pi:C->E of degree d, #E(F_p)=h_E*N and gcd(h_E*d,N)=1, use T(D)=pi^*([h_E]pi_*(D)). Subject to independently verified norm/pullback and group-order identities, T maps rational Jacobian classes into the image of E[N] and T(pi^*P)=[h_E*d]pi^*P. This permits mod-N relations after projecting every factor-base element even when a whole-Jacobian cofactor would annihilate the image.
internal_design_observations.proof_obligation: Verify pi_*pi^*=[d], exact N-order, E cofactor premises and every projected relation; charge map work and compare a direct elliptic baseline.
internal_design_observations.limit: Proposed algebraic interface for the contract only. No implemented projection, run, speedup or independent proof review is claimed.
